title: Counter price sheet
purpose: Printed price sheet for the counters: menu services on page 1, prices by vehicle class on page 2.
facts: Page 1: sixteen menu and common services at the current list (class car), labour hour 135.00, supplies and tire-fee notes (4.85 a tire = 3.50 + 1.35).
Page 2: thirteen jobs priced for car, SUV, truck and van, standard parts.
Spark plugs by class assume 4 / 6 / 8 / 8 cylinders at 21.82 a plug (standard) times the parts class multiplier, plus labour times the job multiplier.
Printed on the day of the rise; replaces earlier sheets.
facts_only_in_this_file: every SUV, truck and van price (the Markdown pages give multipliers and one worked example only)
new_facts: The spark-plug row prices 6 and 8 plugs for SUV, truck and van; the catalogue prices four. The seeder must price a V6 or V8 plug job the same way (per-plug quantity by cylinders) or this row changes.
